<div class="card-body">
'''Hoth: Echo Corridor''' is a [[Light]] [[Location]] ([[Site]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊ホス：エコー基地通路</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
'''Light Side:''' <span lang="ja">ここを支配しているなら、各ターンに１回、４フォース消費して上書きされたホスの位置を１枚、一番上に持ってくることができる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Hoth-Echo-Corridor-PSA-152940009.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Hoth: Echo Base corridor.

'''Light Side:'''
If you control, once per turn, you may use 4 Force to bring one converted Hoth site to the top.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Hoth: Echo Corridor]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
